topic: The match where one bowler took all 10 wickets alone
hook: One man destroyed an entire team by himself.
script: One man destroyed an entire team by himself. In 1956, Jim Laker took all 10 wickets in a single innings. Not 5. Not 8. All 10. Every batsman. Gone. No bowler in Test history has matched it since. One spell. Complete domination. Follow for cricket moments that still feel impossible.
